39:t_10:34.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I don't really get it, but as long as everyone's safe, that's fine.」

39:t_10:35.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'd be in trouble too if anything happened to this $$Ｚクリスタル$$ and these $$Ｚチップ$$, you see. I take the utmost care there.」

39:t_10:36.en:
$$かなめ$$
「$$宗介$$ told me about it, but you really do love $$Ｚチップ$$, huh.」

39:t_10:37.en:
$$かなめ$$
「If you don't mind, will you show me the real thing?」

39:t_10:39.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Beautiful... It's like my consciousness is about to be sucked in...」

39:t_10:42.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I'm fine, I'm fine. I just had a little headache.」

39:t_10:43.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「If that's all, then fine... But if anything happened to $$かなめ$$, I wouldn't be able to face $$宗介$$ either.」

39:t_10:44.en:
$$かなめ$$
「You're making too big a deal of it, $$ＡＧ$$.」

39:t_10:46.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Yeah, yeah. I've heard how it goes from $$アルト$$ and the others.」

39:t_10:47.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then here I go! Let's give it our all again today...」

39:t_10:48.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Business, business! And just for good measure, big business!」

39:t_10:49.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Thank you for the big service. As expected of a 《$$ウィスパード$$》.」

39:t_10:50.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Huh... How do you know that...!」

39:t_10:51.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Hee hee... well, never you mind that. Don't underestimate a dimensional merchant's information network.」

39:t_10:52.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(That's right... your existence will greatly influence what happens from here on...)

40:t_001:2.en:
$$モニカ$$
「It matches the $$ＵＣＷ$$ terrain data at 78.23%.」

40:t_001:4.en:
$$キャシー$$
「Yes. Whereas $$蒼の地球$$ was formed by integrating $$ＵＣＷ$$ and $$ＡＤＷ$$ with the $$ＡＤＷ$$ Earth as its base...」

40:t_001:5.en:
$$キャシー$$
「$$翠の地球$$ is most likely based on $$ＵＣＷ$$, after all.」

40:t_001:6.en:
$$テッサ$$
「According to $$ブルー$$, the northern part of the Central Continent, the largest on $$翠の地球$$, is under the control of the Earth side.」

40:t_001:7.en:
$$テッサ$$
「First we'll descend to the Northern Hemisphere and make contact with the local forces.」

40:t_001:8.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「Units are approaching from $$翠の地球$$...!」

40:t_002:0.en:
$$モニカ$$
「It's a $$サイデリアル$$ interception force!」

40:t_002:1.en:
$$ボビー$$
「What numbers...! And on top of that, there are units I've never seen before!」

40:t_002:2.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Launch all units. If we don't break through here, a descent is impossible!」

40:t_003:0.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Welcome, everyone at $c. I've heard plenty about you.」

40:t_003:3.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「It must be fate that we meet here like this... Allow me to introduce myself.」

40:t_003:4.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「I am $$サルディアス・アクス$$. As you can see, I'm one of the $$サイデリアル$$, and I've been allowed to serve as this unit's commander or some such.」

40:t_003:5.en:
$$ルカ$$
「The enemy commander wants to make contact...?」

40:t_003:6.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Be careful. It could be a ploy to make us lower our guard.」

40:t_003:7.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「No, no... I wouldn't dream that you, who are rumored to be veterans of a hundred battles, would let your guard down over a petty talk from the likes of me.」

40:t_003:8.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「It's just that I have my position too, so this is, strictly speaking, part of my duties, yes indeed.」

40:t_003:9.en:
$n
「Unfortunately, we have no intention of listening.」

40:t_003:10.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Wait, $l. First we see how they make their move.」

40:t_003:11.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Oh, thank you very much. Young people really are too hasty, aren't they? Haste makes waste in everything, as they say.」

40:t_003:12.en:
$$アル$$
「Quite a profound saying. He seems to be a commander with a wealth of life experience.」

40:t_003:14.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「You've gone out of your way to set this up like a parley, so I assume you have some intention behind it. Tell us what it is, and quickly.」

40:t_003:15.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「I did criticize the haste of the young earlier, but well, I'm not exactly overflowing with time myself.」

40:t_003:16.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「With little time left in this old body, wasting time is not something I enjoy.」

40:t_003:19.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Ha ha... It seems my sense of humor doesn't match that of you Earth people.」

40:t_003:20.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Well then, let me get straight to the point. Please surrender at once.」

40:t_004:1.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「That guy...! He was getting his units ready to attack while he blabbered on about worthless stuff!」

40:t_004:3.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Ha ha, thank you for the compliment, but I'm not old enough to deserve the 'old'.」

40:t_004:4.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All units, begin the attack! Target the enemy commander unit!」

40:t_004:5.en:
$$テッサ$$
「We have to think about what comes next. If the operation time passes five minutes, we will force a breakthrough.」

40:t_004:6.en:
$$アルト$$
「Before that, I'm taking that old man down!」

40:t_004:7.en:
$$甲児$$
「I'll show that swindler the power of youth!」

40:t_004:8.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Ha ha... Please go easy on me.」

40:t_005:0.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「Captain, the enemy's aim is...」

40:t_005:1.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Yes... Most likely the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ and the $$マクロス・クォーター$$.」

40:t_005:2.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「If we lose the ships, we'll have no choice but to give up the descent operation... A fitting tactic.」

40:t_005:3.en:
$$テッサ$$
「He has seen through the essence of this battle... That commander, $$サルディアス$$, seems to be a bigger schemer than expected.」

40:t_005:4.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All units, protect the ships...! The enemy will try to break through!」

40:t_005:5.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「It seems they read our hand. They're doing quite well.」

40:t_005:6.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Well... knowing it doesn't mean they can stop it, though, yes.」

40:t_006:0.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Oh dear... After this, I can't look down on $$ギルター$$.」

40:t_006:1.en:
$$テッサ$$
「The enemy commander has been neutralized! Now!」

40:t_007:1.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Captain $$ジェフリー$$! Any more fighting will affect our future strategy!」

40:t_007:2.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Right...! We're forcing a breakthrough!」
